description: Expert frontend architecture review and design for modern web apps. Review existing apps against rendering strategy, state management, Core Web Vitals, bundle efficiency, and project structure. Design new apps with concrete ADRs, performance budgets, and migration paths. Catch bundle bloat, state leaks, hydration mismatches, and performance gaps before they hit production. Stop shipping unnecessary JavaScript.
